AUTH_ORIGIN_REJECTED: The request was refused because it did not come from the application. Reload the page and try again.
AUTH_REAUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again to confirm this action.
AUTH_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
AUTH_INVALID_API_KEY: The API key is not valid.
AUTH_API_KEY_READ_ONLY: This API key can only read, not change anything.
API_KEY_LIMIT_REACHED: You already have the maximum number of active API keys. Revoke one or wait for it to expire.
GUILD_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission to manage this server.
GUILD_BOT_MISSING: The bot is not in this server.
DISCORD_API_ERROR: Discord returned an error. Please try again later.
DISCORD_MISSING_PERMISSIONS: The bot cannot {permission, select, view {view this channel} send {send messages in this channel} other {use this channel}}. Grant it that permission and try again.
DISCORD_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND: Channel not found, or the bot cannot access it.
CHANNEL_IN_USE: This channel is already used by a game or the chatbot. Pick another one.
CHATBOT_CHANNEL_LIMIT_REACHED: This server already has the maximum number of chatbot channels. Remove one first.
CHATBOT_TURN_NOT_FOUND: That chatbot exchange was not found. It may have been deleted already.
LLM_NOT_AVAILABLE: The server has no LLM_KEY_SECRET, so LLM settings cannot be saved yet.
LLM_KEY_REQUIRED: An API key is required (on the first save, or when the API address changes).
EMAIL_VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE: Email verification is not available: the server has no LLM_KEY_SECRET.
EMAIL_VERIFY_DISABLED: Email verification is turned off in this server.
EMAIL_INVALID: That is not a valid email address.
EMAIL_BLOCKED: This email address is not allowed in this server.
EMAIL_NOT_ACCEPTED: This email address does not meet this server's access rules.
EMAIL_ALREADY_USED: This email address is already used by another member of this server.
EMAIL_CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Request a new one.
EMAIL_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Start the verification again.
EMAIL_RESEND_COOLDOWN: Please wait {seconds} seconds before asking for another code.
EMAIL_DAILY_CAP: This server has reached its daily limit of verification emails. Try again tomorrow.
EMAIL_USER_DAILY_CAP: You have asked for too many verification emails today. Try again tomorrow.
EMAIL_SEND_FAILED: The verification email could not be sent. Please try again later.
EMAIL_LIST_NOT_FOUND: That email list was not found. It may have been deleted already.
EMAIL_LIST_EXISTS: An email list with that name already exists.
EMAIL_LIST_FULL: This email list is full: it cannot hold that many addresses.
EMAIL_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many verified members to export in one file (the limit is {max}).
SMTP_NOT_CONFIGURED: No SMTP account is set up, so no email can be sent yet.
SMTP_ADDRESS_BLOCKED: That mail server address is not allowed.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some values are not valid. Check what you entered and try again.
SCHEDULE_LIMIT_REACHED: This server already has the maximum number of scheduled messages waiting. Cancel some or wait for them to be sent.
SCHEDULE_TOO_FAR: That time is too far ahead. Choose an earlier time.
MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The message is longer than 2000 characters, which the bot cannot send.
ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE: The files are larger than the destination server accepts.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

invalidLink.EMPTY: Provide a message link. Right-click a message and choose Copy Message Link.
invalidLink.MALFORMED: That is not a message link. Right-click a message and choose Copy Message Link.
invalidLink.CHANNEL_REQUIRED: A message id alone is not enough here. Paste the full message link.
